findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.drillable.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, trace · Private data: search, query, trace · Public sink: search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, trace · Private data: search, query, trace · Public sink: search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
